chapterInfo.content:
1
Elimelek tutu kɔtena Moab
1Na nna a atemmufoɔ no bu atɛn no mu no, ɛkɔm baa asase no so. Na ɔbarima bi a ɔfiri Betlehem a ɛwɔ Yuda kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔtena Moab asase so ayɛ hɔ hɔhoɔ, ɔno ne ne yere ne ne mmammarima baanu. 2Ɔbarima no din de Elimelek, na ne yere din de Naomi, na ne mmammarima baanu no din de Mahlon ne Kilion, wɔyɛ Efratifoɔ a wɔfiri Betlehem a ɛwɔ Yuda. Na wɔduruu Moab asase so, na wɔtenaa hɔ. 3Na Elimelek, Naomi kunu no wui, na ɛkaa ɔno ne ne mma baanu no. 4Na wɔwaree yerenom Moabfoɔ mu, ɔbaako din de Orpa, na ɔbaako nso din de Rut. Na wɔtenaa hɔ bɛyɛ mfeɛ du. 5Na wɔn baanu no, Mahlon ne Kilion, nso wuwui, na ɛkaa ɔbaa no (Naomi) nko, ne ne mma baanu no, ne kunu wuo no akyi.
Naomi ne n’ase sane kɔ Betlehem
6Ɛnna ɔsɔreeɛ, ɔne ne nsenom baanu no, sɛ ɔresane afiri Moab asase so aba, ɛfiri sɛ ɔtee no wɔ Moab asase so sɛ AWURADE abɛhwɛ ne man na wama wɔn aduane. 7Na ɔfirii deɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na ne nsenom baanu no ka ne ho. Na wɔsii kwan so sɛ wɔresane aba Yuda asase so. 8Na Naomi ka kyerɛɛ ne nsenom baanu no sɛ: Monsane nkɔ mo nanom fie. AWURADE ne mo nni no yie sɛdeɛ mo ne awufoɔ no ne me adi no yi. 9#Rut 3.1 AWURADE mma monnya atenayie mo kununom fie. Na ɔfee wɔn ano; na wɔmaa wɔn nne so sui. 10Na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Dabi, yɛne wo bɛsane akɔ wo manfoɔ nkyɛn. 11Na Naomi kaa sɛ: Me mma, monsane! Adɛn na mo ne me bɛkorɔ? Mmammarima da so wɔ me yam na wɔabɛyɛ mo kununom? 12Me mma, monsane nkɔ! na manyini dodo sɛ mɛnya kunu. Sɛ mese: Mewɔ anidasoɔ, na menya kunu anadwo yi na mewo mmammarima mpo a, 13#Hiob 19.21 mobɛtwɛn wɔn akɔsi sɛ wɔbɛnyini anaa? Mobɛtena hɔ a morenwareɛ anaa? Dabi, me mma, na me na awie me bɔne sene mo, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE nsa afiri adi ne me adi no bɔne. 14Na wɔmaa wɔn nne so suu bio. Na Orpa fee n’ase ano, na Rut deɛ, ɔbataa ne ho.
15Na ɔkaa sɛ: Hwɛ, wo kora asane kɔ ne manfoɔ ne n’anyame nkyɛn. Sane di wo kora akyi! 16#2 Sa 15.21 Na Rut kaa sɛ:
Nhyɛ me sɛ mennya wo hɔ
na mennyae w’akyiri die nsane nkɔ;
na deɛ wokorɔ na mɛkorɔ,
na deɛ wosoɛ na mɛsoɛ;
wo man bɛyɛ me man,
na wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ me Nyankopɔn;
17deɛ wobɛwuo na mɛwuo,
na ɛhɔ ara na wɔbɛsie me;
AWURADE nyɛ me yei
na ebi nka ho,
sɛ gye owuo na ɛbɛtete
me ne wo ntam.
18Na ɔhunuu sɛ wawe ataa so sɛ ɔne no bɛkorɔ no, ɔne no gyaee kasa.
19Na wɔn baanu no nante bɛduruu Betlehem. Na wɔduruu Betlehem no, wɔn nti kuro no nyinaa bɔɔ twi na wɔkaa sɛ: Naomi nie? 20#Eks 15.23 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ:
Mommfrɛ me Naomi,#1.20 NAOMI: Asekyerɛ ne: Deɛ wɔadom no.
na momfrɛ me Mara,#1.20 MARA: Asekyerɛ ne: Nwononwono.
ɛfiri sɛ Tweaduampɔn ne me adi no nwononwono so sɛ!
21Mekɔɔ no ma,
na AWURADE de me hunu na aba.
Adɛn na mofrɛ me Naomi,
na AWURADE abua me atɛn,
na Tweaduampɔn ne me adi no bɔne yi?
22Sɛ Naomi ne n’ase Moabni Rut sane firii Moab asase so baeɛ nie. Na wɔduruu Betlehem no, na wɔafiri atokoɔ twa ase.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
